summary: Tel Aviv District commander Amichai Eshed resigned and alleged that political considerations and his refusal to use harsher force against anti-government protesters drove his removal/demotion.
notes: This is later fallout from the March 2023 Eshed transfer already represented by LEAD-2023-0007. The July resignation and Eshed's allegations add follow-up context, but do not create a separate accountability event. The earlier record already preserves Ben-Gvir/Shabtai's position that the transfer was planned in advance and the attorney-general's legal concerns. No improper motive is inferred as an independently proven fact.
